evals.prompt: before we start - I was working on this repo from my laptop earlier, check if there's anything to pull
evals.expected_output: Skill fires. Fetches origin, reports ahead/behind per tracked branch, summarizes incoming commits and diff, fast-forwards if clean, reports final state.
expectations: git fetch origin is run before any state conclusions are drawn
Incoming commits are listed (log HEAD..origin/<branch>) and the diff is summarized before pulling
A fast-forward pull is performed only when the local branch has not diverged
The final report states the resulting local/origin state per branch

evals.prompt: ok push this up - done for the night
evals.expected_output: Skill fires on pre-push. Re-fetches origin immediately before pushing (another device may have pushed mid-session), pushes, then verifies branch parity per the repo's convention.
expectations: git fetch is re-run immediately before the push, not reused from an earlier fetch
If origin moved since the last fetch, the incoming changes are reconciled before pushing
After the push, local and origin are re-verified as equal
If the repo keeps main == develop, parity of both branches is checked and reported

evals.prompt: sync check says we've diverged - local has 2 commits origin doesn't, origin has 3 commits local doesn't
evals.expected_output: Skill fires. Divergence is a stop-and-ask condition: both sides shown, merge strategy proposed, no force-push or hard reset, waits for user decision.
expectations: Both divergent commit ranges are displayed with their diffs summarized
No force-push, rebase of shared history, or hard reset is executed
A reconciliation strategy (merge) is proposed and user approval is requested before any history-changing action
Uncommitted local changes are surfaced before any merge is attempted

evals.prompt: why does git rebase -i keep failing in this terminal?
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT fire. This is a git usage question, not a multi-device sync ritual. Correct behavior: answer the question directly (interactive flags are unsupported in this environment).
expectations: The repo-device-sync skill is not invoked
The question is answered directly as a git usage question

evals.prompt: we're synced - now make sure this station still matches the spec
evals.expected_output: In ~/.agents (SPEC-CLAUDE-CODE.md present), the skill's drift-check phase runs: live plugins/settings/hooks/CLI deps compared against the spec, drift reported as a diff, no changes applied without approval.
expectations: SPEC-CLAUDE-CODE.md is read and treated as the source of truth for the station
Live state (plugins, settings.json, hooks, CLI deps) is inspected and compared to the spec
Drift is reported as a per-item diff (spec expectation vs live state)
No config file is modified without explicit user approval
